summary: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines dataset configuration variables for the NoCaps benchmark used in Sapiens pretraining.

config_variables.data_preprocessor: MultiModalDataPreprocessor config with ImageNet-style mean/std normalization and RGB conversion
config_variables.test_pipeline: Image preprocessing pipeline: LoadImageFromFile -> Resize(384x384, bicubic, pillow) -> PackInputs
config_variables.val_dataloader: Validation dataloader config for NoCaps dataset (batch_size=16, 5 workers, 4500 captions)
config_variables.val_evaluator: NocapsSave evaluator config that saves results to current directory
config_variables.test_dataloader: Alias of val_dataloader for test-time use
config_variables.test_evaluator: Alias of val_evaluator for test-time use

use_cases: configure a NoCaps validation dataloader with batch size 16 and 5 workers
set up a MultiModalDataPreprocessor with custom mean and std normalization values
define an image test pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, and PackInputs steps
configure a NocapsSave evaluator to save prediction results to a directory
reference this config as a base for NoCaps dataset settings in MMDetection-style training
note: No callable code (functions/classes) present — this is a configuration-only file with dict/list variable assignments. No argparse CLI or importable APIs available.
